text.p: Lithuanian newspapers carried the following reports in their Monday editions. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
LIETUVOS RYTAS
- Stunt pilot Jurgis Kairys successfully flew under a nine metre high bridge over the Neris river in Vilnius on Sunday.
- Lithuania's national basketball team was sixth in the European championship in Spain and won the chance to compete in the world championship in Greece next year.
- Around twenty local businessmen who got rich in 1992-93 have committed suicide, been sent to prison or had to flee the country to avoid imprisonment.
- Transport minister Algis Zhvaliauskas said on Friday that the ministry will attempt to preserve its controlling stake in key Klaipeda port companies during the first stage of privatisation.
- Snoras Bank posted a 7.8 million litas unaudited profit for the first half of 1997 compared to 3.78 million litas in the same period last year.
- The Bank of Lithuania will not allow the commercial banks to issue credits in hard currency on the domestic market.
- Lithuanian Energy stopped exporting elecric energy to Belarus from July first after it refused to pay eight cents for kilowat hour of electricity.
- LUKoil Baltija, which owns 32 service stations in Lithuania, intends to open ten new ones this year. It also plans to open 14 in Latvia in 1997.
- Swedish state energy concern Vattenfall would like to participate in the privatisation of Kaunas hydro power plant though it remains unclear when its privatisation might start.
VERSLO ZINIOS
- Klaipedos Nafta handled 1.42 million tonnes of oil products in the first half of 1997 compared to 1.58 million tonnes in the same period last year.
- European Affiars Minister Laima Andrikiene said that a privatisation tender for the country's biggest hotel, Lietuva Hotel, is to be announced on Monday.
- Klaipeda Stevedoring company handled 4.474 million tonnes of cargoes in the first half of 1997, a 31 percent increase over the same period last year.
- Direct foreign investment in Lithuania amounted to almost $694 million as of the end of April.
RESPUBLIKA
- The unemployment in Lithuania was 5.3 percent in June and there were 93,000 unemployed people registered in the country.
- Lithuanian President Algirdas Brazauskas leaves on Monday for a four-day official visit to France.
- Germanany's Der Spiegel magazine said that the European Commission decided to postpone the expansion of the European Union.
- Snoras Bank said on Friday that the deposits in the bank exceeded 300 million litas and its assets were 448 million litas at the end of June. -- Andrius Vilkancas, Vilnius newsroom +370 2 22 35 17
